anchors.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset
anchors.reason: The candidate paper describes the 'bigP3BCI' dataset as a curated resource from 'previous visual P300-based BCI speller studies,' indicating it is a collection (umbrella) rather than the specific dataset release.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a technical specification and tool for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a standard used by this dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard for EEG data, which is a technical specification/tool used for organizing and sharing data, not a description of the BigP3BCI dataset itself.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 32 channels in a standard 10-20 montage, sampled at 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency notch filtering. Subjects performed a visual P300 speller task using a 6×6 checkerboard stimulus with row-column and random presentation modes. Trial intervals were defined from 0 to 1.0 seconds post-stimulus.
